input.command:
python3 -c '
# Check table front leg base coords:
# Pose: X = 0.7071, Y = 1.7071, theta = 0 deg
# Camera: f=256, cx=cy=255.5, h=1.55
# Front-right leg base: x_pix ~ 184.5, y_pix = 375
# Front-left leg base: x_pix ~ 92.5, y_pix = 375
# Note: since y_pix = 375 for both front legs, they are at the exact same depth!
f = 256.0
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5
h = 1.55
d_front = f * h / (375.0 - cy)
Y_front = 1.7071 + d_front
X_fl = 0.7071 + (92.5 - cx) / f * d_front
X_fr = 0.7071 + (184.5 - cx) / f * d_front

print(f"Table front legs depth: {d_front:.4f} m -> Y = {Y_front:.4f} m")
print(f"Table front-left leg X: {X_fl:.4f} m, front-right leg X: {X_fr:.4f} m")
print(f"Table front width: {X_fr - X_fl:.4f} m, center X: {(X_fl + X_fr)/2:.4f} m")
'
